$description: Union instrument catalog (docs/58h): the frozen xlsx snapshot plus one row per disk file the xlsx never listed. The brain consumes this file as the effective catalog; `source` on each entry marks xlsx vs disk origin. `contentHash` is a SHA-256 over the canonical bytes of `entries` and is verified on load.

LEGACY_PROVENANCE.transform: Per sheet: forward-fill column 1 (subcategory); trim every string; split `add. styles` on comma; coerce `bpm` to integer or null; pass `key`, `normalisation`, `status`, `legacyReplacement` through verbatim. Rows whose library AND preset are both blank are dropped (subcategory-declaration rows) and reported in rowsSkipped.subcategoryHeaderOnly. Empty sheets are reported but not flagged.

unionProvenance.transform: From the source audit `unmatchedDiskFiles`, drop variant renders (`_modified`, `<KEY> <BPM>bpm`, ` - <BPM>` trailers) and the `percussionLoops` loop domain; invert RULE_SIMPLE on each survivor to recover (family, lowLevel, mainStyle, library, preset); keep only files whose parsed entry round-trips back to the exact disk path via preferredExpectedPath; assign deterministic disk sourceRows; union with the xlsx rows; re-sort and re-hash exactly as build-snapshot does.
